They are drawn as bit patterns: a random low dword (mantissa noise) under high dwords for 0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1, -1, ~0.1, ~0.95 (fractions), 1000, -1000, 131071 (int32 near 2^31 after the scale), 2^31 and +-1e6 (indefinite): every pattern is a finite double, the fistp never faults. Large esi together with the indefinite ebx (whose product with a word difference of an odd multiple of 0x4000 puts c4 next to 0x80000000) reaches the signed-overflow clamp 0x407267 'esi - c4 < 0 with esi >= c4', which the generic mix hits about once in 10^4 cases. Words +0x158/+0x2b8 of the next record (0x8944f8/0x894658) add the pairs 1/0x4001, 0x1000/0x5000, 0x2000/0x6000 and 0x4000/0x8000 to state_0040705f's list (zero still about a third), since only their difference and zero tests matter.
